content.headline: SOLSTICE GT
content.subheadline: Engineered for the horizon. Built for the moment before it.
content.body: Every great drive begins with arrival. Out of the dark, one signature: the V-shaped intake, the light blade, the wing that promises what comes next.

content.headline: A Silhouette Cut From Motion Itself
content.body: The Solstice GT's profile was shaped in a wind tunnel before it was ever sketched on paper. Every line — from the low, cab-forward roofline to the sculpted rear haunches and the carbon side intakes behind each door — exists because air demanded it. Crowned by a fixed carbon-fiber rear wing, the result is a shape that looks fast standing still.
highlights: Sculpted carbon-fiber front splitter with V-shaped air intake
Carbon-fiber side intakes, side skirts, and rear diffuser
Ultra-thin LED signature headlights and the illuminated V emblem
Three signature finishes: Crimson Red, Storm Silver, Cobalt Blue

content.headline: Precision at Every RPM
content.body: Step inside and the engineering meets you first: hexagon-stitched leather sport seats, Alcantara surfaces, and carbon-fiber trim that put you exactly where the drive happens. Beneath the composed exterior sits a powertrain built for both restraint and release. Twin-turbocharged and paired with an adaptive all-wheel drive system, it delivers power exactly when — and only when — you ask for it. Forged wheels, Michelin Pilot Sport 4 S tires, and red six-piston carbon-ceramic brakes keep every ounce of it under control.

highlights: Hexagon-quilted leather sport seats with red contrast stitching and embossed VELOR headrests
Alcantara-wrapped steering wheel with red paddle shifters
Digital instrument cluster and carbon-fiber trim
Forged 21-inch alloy wheels with center V cap
Michelin Pilot Sport 4 S tires (265/30 R21)
Six-piston red calipers with drilled carbon-ceramic rotors

content.headline: Named for the Longest Light
content.body: The solstice marks the point where light lingers longest before the turn. It's a fitting name for a car designed to extend the moment behind the wheel — where the drive itself becomes the destination. Dusk, an open road, and the horizon still glowing: this is the hour the Solstice GT was built for. Three years of design iteration, wind-tunnel testing, and track validation went into a single goal: make the ordinary drive feel occasional.

quote.text: We didn't want to build a faster car. We wanted to build a car that made you want to drive slower, longer.

finalReveal.headline: Your Horizon. Your Terms.
finalReveal.body: The Solstice GT is available now at select VELOR showrooms in Crimson Red, Storm Silver, and Cobalt Blue, with private test-drive appointments by request. Configure your build, choose your finish, and reserve your place in the next chapter of VELOR.
